method: Official help and program pages inspected. These document stated rules only; no independent payout verification or complete 13-criterion review.

audits.phase: Evaluation and Pro account where applicable

findings.finding: High Stakes: orders executed within 2 minutes either side of high-impact news can have profits removed while losses remain. The rule concerns order execution, including triggered pending entries, not simply holding a preexisting position.
findings.consequence: Profitable news-window executions can be excluded while losing executions count.

findings.finding: High Stakes Pro: payouts every 14 days, $50K account payout cap $3000 and minimum P&L $300; $100K cap $4000 and minimum P&L $500. Evaluate phase has no payouts.
findings.consequence: Payout ceiling and minimum vary by account size.

audits.conflictToResolve: Official FAQ articles differ on whether all orders versus only new-position opening executions trigger news restriction; reconcile applicable version before publication.

findings.finding: For affected funded Stellar accounts, 5 minutes before and after high-impact news, only 40% of profitable trade result counts toward balance while losses remain fully counted. Market and pending orders including TP/SL are covered.
findings.consequence: Trader retains only part of gains but full losses on news-window executions.

audits.program: E8 One, E8 Signature, E8 Zero, E8 Pro

findings.finding: E8 One Performance has 40% Best Day and payout net-profit threshold >50% daily drawdown. E8 Signature Performance has 35% Best Day, minimum payout $100, five 0.3%-profitable days between payouts after first, buffer and size-based payout caps.
findings.consequence: Eligibility and available withdrawal differ materially by product.

findings.finding: E8 Pro Performance has no consistency rule or payout cap, requests daily after 1% profit; only 50% of profits are requestable and remaining 50% retained as buffer. Static drawdown moves to initial balance at first payout.
findings.consequence: Headline profit split is not equivalent to immediate withdrawal of 100% of generated profits.

findings.finding: Risk team reserves ability to impose restrictions, terminate agreement or withhold payouts if it judges trading not consistent or sustainable. Full contractual terms and appeal process needed before B1 points.
findings.consequence: Payout can depend on qualitative strategy assessment beyond numeric limits.

findings.finding: E8 Zero consistency applies in Challenge, not Performance; E8 Pro and E8 Zero Performance have no consistency rule. E8 One and Signature Performance use product-specific best-day requirements.
findings.consequence: A global 'E8 has a consistency rule' label would mislead.

audits.conflictToResolve: Verify any newer FAQ revisions and product-specific restrictions before release.

remainingPerFirm: B1 full contracting agreement and appeals
